name: Bricozor
description: French online hardware and DIY store based in Normandy, listing about 69,000 products in hardware, tools, electrical, plumbing, heating and garden. It says it ships across France; other countries are not mentioned on the pages read.
description_es: Ferretería y tienda de bricolaje online francesa con sede en Normandía, con unos 69.000 productos de ferretería, herramientas, electricidad, fontanería, calefacción y jardín. Indica que envía a toda Francia; no se mencionan otros países en las páginas consultadas.

ships_to.notes: Homepage and about page say delivery everywhere in France; Corsica and overseas territories are not mentioned.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: No in-store or click-and-collect pickup is mentioned on the pages read; orders ship from a warehouse in Normandy.
